name: Living Shadow

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Ravenloft Dark Gift. Your shadow works a Mage Hand and lengthens your reach; a natural 1 lets it take you over for a moment.

benefits.name: Shadow Hand
benefits.summary: You know Mage Hand; the hand is your shadow.
benefits.text: You know the Mage Hand cantrip; the hand is your own shadow stretching out. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you take the gift).

benefits.name: Shadow Reach
benefits.summary: When you make a melee attack, your shadow can extend its reach by 10 feet (PB times per Long Rest).
benefits.text: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your shadow can carry it: the attack's reach increases by 10 feet. You can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest.

drawback.name: Drawback
drawback.summary: On a natural 1: Wisdom save (DC 13 + PB) or your shadow takes over until the start of your next turn (Incapacitated; it moves you, attacks or drops you Prone at random).
drawback.text: Whenever you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus); on a failure your shadow rebels: you have the Incapacitated condition until the start of your next turn, and on your next turn it drags your body at random (roll a d6: 1-2 it walks you up to your Speed in a random direction, 3-4 it makes you attack the nearest creature, 5-6 it throws you Prone).
